step1_analysis.description: A parallel common-source amplifier stage used for signal summing or multiplexing in high-speed transceivers. It features multiple inputs (VIN1, VIN2) and bias controls (VB) driving a shared output node (VOUT).

paper_reference.title: Prospects of CMOS Technology for High-Speed Optical Communication Circuits

voltage_gain.description: AC voltage gain from VIN1 to VOUT

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the chosen load resistor. With a 1k load, gain is around 2.2 dB, which is close to the paper's 0.58 dB for broadband stages.
Matches the 5 GHz operating frequency reported in the paper, limited by the parasitic capacitance of the four parallel transistors.
Calculated based on SKY130 NMOS square-law model at 1.8V supply.

dc_output_voltage.description: DC bias voltage at the output node

sky130_expected.reasoning: Ensures the transistors remain in saturation (VDS > VGS - Vth).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure AC gain, bandwidth, transient response, and DC power of the summing amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Summing Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

XM2 VOUT VB A GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VOUT VB B GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VOUT VIN2 B GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM1 VOUT VIN1 A GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* Ground connections for source nodes
VA A 0 0
VB_node B 0 0

* Load resistor
RLOAD VDD VOUT 1k

* DC and AC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB VB 0 0.54
VVIN2 VIN2 0 DC 0.9 AC 0
VVIN1 VIN1 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 100MEG 0 0)

.control
* DC Analysis
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(VOUT)

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1MEG 100G
let gain_db = vdb(VOUT)
meas ac midband_gain max gain_db
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db='midband_gain - 3' fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 20n
meas tran v_max max v(VOUT)
meas tran v_min min v(VOUT)
meas tran t_rise trig v(VOUT) val=1.05 rise=1 targ v(VOUT) val=1.2 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(VOUT) val=1.2 fall=1 targ v(VOUT) val=1.05 fall=1

quit
.endc
.end
